name: Potato chips - Tandoori chicken tikka flavoured
ingredients_raw: Fresh Potatoes, Refined Sunflower Oil, Salt, Maltodextrin, Sugar, Spices Powder (Coriander, Chilli, Fenugreek, Cumin, Ginger, Cinnamon, Clove, Black Pepper, Nutmeg, Cardamom, Bay Leaf), Salt, Dehydrated Powder (Garlic, Onion), Black Salt, Acidity Regulator (E 330, E 296), Flavor Enhancers (E 627, E 631), Anticaking Agent (E 551). CONTAINS ADDED NATURAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVORING SUBSTANCES. Allergen Advisory: Produced in factory which handles Peanuts, Soya, Wheat, Sesame & other Nuts on separate machines.
